title: On a phone the call docks as a strip at the top instead of floating

tasks.title: The docked strip on narrow screens, collapsed and expanded, switching frames without touching the call
Resume a call the browser paused in the background

acs.text: WHILE the viewport is narrower than 600px THE SYSTEM SHALL show the call as a full-width strip docked under the top inset, with no drag or resize handle
scenarios: AC-001 a docked strip on a narrow screen

acs.text: WHEN the strip is collapsed (the default) THE SYSTEM SHALL show it 48px high with participants' avatars, the speaking ring, the microphone toggle, Leave and Expand; WHEN expanded it SHALL show the active speaker at 16:9 across the width with the same controls, and Collapse SHALL return to 48px
WHEN the viewport crosses 600px in either direction during a call THE SYSTEM SHALL switch between the strip and the floating window without disconnecting
scenarios: AC-003 rotating or resizing keeps the call

acs.text: WHEN the tab becomes visible again after the browser suspended its audio or dropped the connection THE SYSTEM SHALL say the call was paused and offer one button that resumes audio or rejoins
scenarios: AC-004 coming back to a paused call

acs.text: WHILE collapsed, the strip SHALL not receive other participants' video
